definitions.explanation: A person or entity against whom a legal action is brought in court. In criminal cases, the person accused of a crime; in civil cases, the party being sued.

examples.japanese: {被告|ひこく}は{無罪|むざい}を{主張|しゅちょう}した。
{被告|ひこく}に{懲役|ちょうえき}{三|さん}{年|ねん}の{判決|はんけつ}が{下|くだ}された。
examples.english: The defendant was sentenced to three years in prison.

examples.japanese: {裁判|さいばん}で{被告|ひこく}{側|がわ}の{弁護士|べんごし}が{証拠|しょうこ}の{不十分|ふじゅうぶん}さを{指摘|してき}した。
examples.english: At the trial, the defense attorney pointed out the insufficiency of the evidence.

notes:
USAGE:
In criminal trials, the full term is {被告人|ひこくにん}, but {被告|ひこく} is commonly used in news reports and everyday language. In civil cases, {被告|ひこく} refers to the party being sued.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {原告|げんこく}: plaintiff (the party bringing the case)
- {被告|ひこく}: defendant (the party being accused/sued)
- {容疑者|ようぎしゃ}: suspect (before indictment)
- {被告人|ひこくにん}: defendant (formal, criminal law)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {被告|ひこく}{側|がわ}: the defense side
- {被告|ひこく}{席|せき}: the defendant's seat (in court)
- {被告人|ひこくにん}: the accused (formal)
- {被告|ひこく}に{判決|はんけつ}が{下|くだ}る: a verdict is handed down to the defendant
